title: Ford: signposts and settlements on the page
why: Open 1, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 1, Reach 2 = 6. The rules, the orders and the view data are built and tested; the brief names every file and check. It is page work in the page's own patterns (a layer, a panel shape, two buttons, a play script, check.mjs), judged partly by a screenshot. About 8 files, 350 lines. Sonnet should finish in one attempt with check.sh green.

title: Review the piece
why: Open 2, New 2, Miss 2, Importance 2, Reach 1 = 9. A cold read of a rule set its author also judged: the diff against main, the Decided lines against core/tests/settle.rs, scores.md against the sweep files, the played games, and the ledger lines to add to founding.md, clans.md and page.md from the result's decisions. The scores say settlements cost their civ Standing as built; the review weighs whether that merges with the store idea open, or waits for it.
